name: google-search-console
description: Read Google Search Console: performance queries, indexing checks, SEO analysis and a white-label HTML audit report.
long_description:
Seventeen read-only tools over the Google Search Console API, plus a self-contained HTML SEO audit in English or Italian.

Requires `uv` on the machine (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/), which provides the `uvx` command this bundle launches. Credentials: create a Desktop app OAuth client in Google Cloud Console with the Search Console API enabled, then run `uvx mcp-google-search-console auth` once to obtain a refresh token.

The OAuth scope is read-only: no tool can modify a property, a sitemap or anything else in Search Console.

client_id.title: Google OAuth client ID
client_id.description: From a Desktop app OAuth client in Google Cloud Console, with the Search Console API enabled.

client_secret.title: Google OAuth client secret
client_secret.description: The client secret paired with the client ID above.

refresh_token.title: Google OAuth refresh token
refresh_token.description: Run `uvx mcp-google-search-console auth` once to obtain it.

report_language.title: Audit report language
report_language.description: Language for the generated HTML report.

tools.name: gsc_sites
tools.description: List every property the authenticated account can read.

tools.name: gsc_site_details
tools.description: Permission level and property type for one property.

tools.name: gsc_query
tools.description: Query the Search Analytics report: clicks, impressions, CTR, position.

tools.name: gsc_performance_overview
tools.description: Site totals for a period, compared with the preceding one.

tools.name: gsc_compare_periods
tools.description: Join two periods on one dimension and rank the rows by click delta.

tools.name: gsc_quick_wins
tools.description: Queries close enough to the top that a push would pay off.

tools.name: gsc_ctr_gaps
tools.description: Rows that rank well but are clicked far less than their position implies.

tools.name: gsc_cannibalization
tools.description: Queries where several pages of the site compete for the same result.

tools.name: gsc_traffic_drops
tools.description: Pages that lost clicks against the baseline, each with a likely cause.

tools.name: gsc_content_decay
tools.description: Pages sliding down month after month.

tools.name: gsc_alerts
tools.description: What changed sharply enough to be worth a message today.

tools.name: gsc_portfolio
tools.description: Every accessible property at a glance, ranked worst first.

tools.name: gsc_indexing_issues
tools.description: Check whether a batch of URLs is indexed, and why not when they are not.

tools.name: gsc_inspect_url
tools.description: Full URL Inspection for one page: index, mobile, rich results and AMP.

tools.name: gsc_sitemaps
tools.description: List the sitemaps Google knows about, with errors and warnings.

tools.name: gsc_doctor
tools.description: Report the server's configuration and whether Search Console answers.

tools.name: gsc_audit
tools.description: Build a complete, self-contained HTML SEO audit for one property.
